description: This file defines Express route handlers for user-related API endpoints in a Node.js backend. It includes endpoints for seeding demo users, retrieving tenant summaries, listing users with pagination and filtering, fetching user details by flexible identifiers, obtaining active user trends, getting user projects from session data, and aggregating referral sources. The file also manages in-memory caching for certain queries and integrates with MongoDB via Mongoose models.

methods.name: buildTenantSummaryCacheKey
methods.description: Constructs a cache key string for tenant summary queries based on query parameters.

methods.name: buildActiveTrendCacheKey
methods.description: Constructs a cache key string for active trend queries based on query parameters.

methods.name: getActiveTrendCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached active trend data if available and not expired.

methods.name: setActiveTrendCache
methods.description: Stores active trend data in cache with expiration timestamp.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached tenant summary data if available and not expired.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Stores tenant summary data in cache with expiration timestamp.
